targets.rawSql: SELECT time_bucket('1 minute',ts_exchange) AS time,count(*) AS trades FROM trades WHERE $__timeFilter(ts_exchange) AND symbol='BTC-PERP' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT time_bucket('1 minute',ts_exchange) AS time,sum(qty) AS vol FROM trades WHERE $__timeFilter(ts_exchange) AND symbol='BTC-PERP' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT time_bucket('1 minute',ts_exchange) AS time,sum(CASE WHEN side='buy' THEN qty ELSE -qty END) AS delta FROM trades WHERE $__timeFilter(ts_exchange) AND symbol='BTC-PERP' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT ts_exchange AS time,open_interest FROM open_interest WHERE $__timeFilter(ts_exchange) AND symbol='BTC-PERP' ORDER BY 1
SELECT ts_exchange AS time,funding_rate FROM funding WHERE $__timeFilter(ts_exchange) AND symbol='BTC-PERP' ORDER BY 1
SELECT time_bucket('5 minutes',ts_exchange) AS time,side,sum(qty*price) AS usd FROM liquidations WHERE $__timeFilter(ts_exchange) AND symbol='BTC-PERP' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1
SELECT count(*) AS hb FROM heartbeats WHERE ts>NOW()-INTERVAL '1 hour'
SELECT count(*) AS gaps FROM data_gaps WHERE resolved=false AND detected_at>NOW()-INTERVAL '1 hour'
SELECT count(*) AS total FROM trades WHERE symbol='BTC-PERP'
SELECT percentile_cont(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (ts_received-ts_exchange))*1000) AS p99 FROM trades WHERE ts_exchange>NOW()-INTERVAL '5 minutes' AND symbol='BTC-PERP'

SELECT time_bucket('1 minute',ts_exchange) AS time,percentile_cont(0.50) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (ts_received-ts_exchange))*1000) AS p50,percentile_cont(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (ts_received-ts_exchange))*1000) AS p99 FROM trades WHERE $__timeFilter(ts_exchange) AND symbol='BTC-PERP' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT detected_at,symbol,gap_start,gap_end,round(gap_sec::numeric,2) AS gap_sec,resolved FROM data_gaps ORDER BY detected_at DESC LIMIT 50
